title: Piercing Statue Solo #006 (쓰리쿼터 · P8 집중형 · 내용물 투명(내용물·사파이어+나비) · 경계 쇄골선 · 체형 colossal, statuesque chest, a · 번 · 코퍼 · 메이크업 레바논웨딩글램 · 금속 혼합 · 재질 내용물·사파이어+나비 · 쥬얼리 목걸이·팔찌·반지 JQ5)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, three-quarter statue portrait. ONE woman, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so her whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually rounded, deliberately carved tips right at the knee, where the leg would bend, her face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop of just the face. Where her sculpted form comes to an end at her knees, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Lebanese woman — radiant glowing bridal makeup, dramatic long lashes, a soft rose lip, warm fair skin, vivid copper-orange hair styled in low bun. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. Her neck, the hollows above her collarbones and the tops of her shoulders carry the same real living skin as her face: visible pores and fine skin grain, a soft sheen of natural skin oils on the highest planes, faint fine peach-fuzz hairs catching the rim light, gentle tonal variation with a natural warm flush, and the fine natural creases of a real neck — never airbrushed, never smooth like plastic. Like any real person she is slightly asymmetrical: a few small natural beauty marks and freckles scattered unevenly, one side of her neck and shoulder very slightly warmer and more freckled than the other.

Piercings: All eight piercings gather on the left side of her face and ear, and the right side stays bare: on the left ear five pieces — a huge mixed-metal bar hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide mixed-metal ear cuff, two smaller mixed-metal rings and a small mixed-metal stud at the top; two mixed-metal pieces in a row along the outer end of the left eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; a small mixed-metal ring passes through the left nostril. Each piece carries small diamonds set into the metal. All jewelry is real mixed metal (yellow gold, silver, copper and rose gold, alternating piece by piece), sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Jewelry: besides the piercings she wears well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of gold necklaces and chains resting on her neck, collarbones and upper chest; well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of gold bracelets and bangles on both wrists; well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of gold rings on her fingers, all of it real, sitting on and over the material of her body and her real neck and hair without covering her eyes, her face or her piercings.

Physique: A colossal, statuesque chest, a broad heavy torso and wide statuesque hips, both thighs clearly separate and individually shaped, all on a grand imperial scale.

Body: From the collarbones down, her whole body — shoulders, arms, hands, chest, belly, hips and both distinct thighs — is ONE solid, continuous block of deep blue sapphire crystal, with fine silky needle inclusions forming a soft star-like shimmer, near-midnight navy where thickest and pale cornflower at every thin edge, carved as one uniform sculpted mass, never hollow, never split down the centre. Yet suspended deep within this solid material, visible through it exactly like objects frozen inside a single flawless crystal, are a dozen small, perfectly carved crystal butterflies with delicate translucent wings, each one a paler, brighter facet than the crystal around it, spread naturally from her chest down through her belly, hips and both thighs, each one fully embedded in the solid material with no cavity, no hollow chamber and no liquid around it — the material itself grew solid around them. The material reads as one unbroken solid mass throughout; the embedded shapes are simply what is visible deep inside it, not a separate vessel. Right at the knee, where the leg would bend, each thigh individually curves inward and rounds off into its own smooth, deeply polished tip — the two thighs stay clearly separate all the way down, never merging, fusing or tapering into a single base — no calves, no feet, nothing continues below either tip — the material simply reaching its natural end on each leg, both rounded tips resting side by side on the surface beneath her.

Transmission: everything below the collarbones is a transparent material that light passes through, while her real face, ears and neck are opaque living flesh that no light passes through. The background and its light sources are visible straight through her body, bent and tinted by the material, with bright refraction edges and soft coloured shadows. Her face stays completely opaque.

Boundary: a sharp jagged line runs around the base of the neck and across both collarbones — real skin above, material immediately below. There is no line down the centre of her body. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step above her flesh, casting a crisp shadow — her skin beside it stays smooth and even. The rounded tip is the material's own carved finish, always the clean, deliberate result of a sculpture — never the edge of a photograph. Shards interlock along the collarbone line only.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a warm rose pink on one side and a soft cream on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, her left hand (solid material) resting on her flared hip, her right arm held clear of her body with the hand (solid material) relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: the glowing backdrop floods her body from behind, so a warm rose pink passes through one side and a soft cream passes through the other. A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears only; a thin cool rim light traces her whole figure. Only her face, ears and neck read as real skin. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
